prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: Building on c011 (timing-driven weighting + decay<=0.5), lower the momentum decay further to 0.25 so criticality tracks the evolving placement even more tightly and spreads weight across many moderately-critical nets (TNS-friendly), without starving the single worst path (WNS).
Rule-based digest:
total=-inf robust(mean-std)=-inf min_case=-inf all_valid=False
  failures: bp_fe-ng45/1001:legalization overlap; bp_fe-ng45/1002:stage timeout; bp_fe-ng45/1003:stage timeout; bp-ng45/1001:KeyError in partition; bp-ng45/1002:KeyError in partition; bp-ng45/1003:legalization overlap
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: Invalid: mixed legality (legalization overlap), crash (KeyError in partition), and timeout failures. Systematic across all seeds for bp_fe-ng45 (timeouts/overlap) and bp-ng45 (KeyError/overlap), so the candidate says nothing about the hypothesis. Likely the tighter decay destabilizes partitioning/legalization. To make the idea legal: gate decay=0.25 behind a feasibility check, add partition-key fallback, and cap runtime; re-run on a single seed first to isolate whether overlap stems from weighting or partition crash.
